name: pi-forge
description: pi-forge — slash-controlled discipline for pi: 5 high-signal tools (intent/plan/memo/intel/check) via /forge. Opt-in, not auto-nag. Faster, Cheaper, Reliable, Durable.

scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
scripts.size: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');let t=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist')){try{t+=fs.statSync('dist/'+f).size}catch{}};console.log('dist '+Math.round(t/1024)+'KB');" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');console.log(fs.readdirSync('dist').map(f=>f+': '+fs.statSync('dist/'+f).size+'B').join('\n'))"
scripts.audit: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run size
